svg.text: CHANGED: forward u_mfw now nand2_4 (4 copies)
F03 master latch of DUT4: forward strengthened (nand2_2 -> nand2_4)
With g1 = g2 = 1 (clock high, door closed) each NAND is an inverter: forward u_mfw drives mq from mqb, keeper u_mkp drives mqb from mq.
CHANGE from DUT2: the forward u_mfw has four copies of each transistor in parallel (twice the baseline). Simulated tau: 88.9 ps -> 102.3 ps (the added capacitance outweighs the added drive).
Names: fw = forward u_mfw, kp = keeper u_mkp; P/N = PMOS/NMOS. Two (or four) transistors side by side = copies in parallel.
mq: master node driven by the forward gate
mqb: master node driven by the keeper gate
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
